system.description:
Your command over the barrier between worlds is nearly absolute; you weave the very fabric of the Shroud, thinning it to admit the dead or thickening it to bar them.

Expend a Willpower Trait to exercise Shroud Mastery, then raise or lower the Shroud as you desire, each Mental Trait spent altering its strength by one point in either direction. You may raise the Shroud to a maximum of 10 or lower it to a minimum of three (typical ratings are 7 or 8, dropping to 4 or 5 in cemeteries, crypts and Elysium). A stronger Shroud hinders wraiths from touching the living world; a weaker one aids them.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
